# TaskKill

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py in kagantmr/zuzu. Do not edit. -->

Terminates another task, as if it had called Quit(ERR_DEAD).

| Number | Selector | Blocking | Since |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0x0C` SVC_MANAGETASK | `MNGTASK_KILL (1)` | no | 2.0 |

```c
Err TaskKill(Handle h);
```

**Registers:** `(task) -> r0 status`

Killing a faulted task also unfreezes its space. Killing a task that has already exited succeeds and does nothing.

## Parameters

| Name | Direction | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `h` | in | Task handle with PERM_CNTL. |

## Returns

ZUZU_OK, or an error code.

## Errors

| Error | Condition |
|---|---|
| [`ERR_BADHANDLE`](../errors.md#err_badhandle) | `h` is not a live handle. |
| [`ERR_BADTYPE`](../errors.md#err_badtype) | `h` is not a task. |
| [`ERR_NOPERM`](../errors.md#err_noperm) | `h` lacks PERM_CNTL. |
| [`ERR_BADARG`](../errors.md#err_badarg) | `h` is the caller itself or -1; use Quit() to end yourself. |
